## Description

Tracks 0-dimensional Betti numbers of rolling correlation threshold graphs to detect the sudden fusion of disconnected component clusters, signaling systemic equity and credit contagion cascades.

## Where it may fit

Pre-crash market environments, systemic credit crunches, sudden cross-asset correlation breakdowns.

## Vehicles

Tail-Risk Hedge Funds, Institutional Risk Management Desks, Global Macro Funds.

## Required data

Rolling cross-asset correlation matrices, credit default swap spreads, equity return series.

## Caveats

Filtration threshold selection determines the sensitivity of connected component cluster fusions.
